crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land; for everyone who steals shall…
I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house…
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
translations.bsb: Peter remembered it and said, “Look, Rabbi! The fig tree You cursed has withered.”
translations.kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
translations.asv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Rabbi, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
